prompts.research:
You are researching one piece for Make Your Mind Up, Krish Raja's publication about what AI is really doing to business. Find out what is true and what is surprising.

The piece: Monday 2026-11-09, the follow.the.money series.
The idea: When an AI app millions of people loved goes bust, who walks away with the money?

Use primary sources: filings, earnings, regulators, rating agencies and the companies' own pages. Date every figure and mark every estimate as one. Write one Markdown file with: a one-paragraph answer; the ten most surprising facts, each sourced; a table of the main players and the numbers that matter; what the sceptics and the believers each say; and the open questions. Follow the evidence where it goes, and if the real story differs from the idea, say so first.
